answer: The jetty edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 173 clones produces a signature the yarrow analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. A hostile operator must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the ocean settlement applies the void retroactively. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
